_note: Everything the setup script configures besides the menu. Fill in the real values before running. Anything you leave blank / null is skipped.

admin.//: If this account still shows 'must change password', set newPassword too — the script will change it and use it from then on. If you've already changed it, put the real password above and leave newPassword empty.

//tables: Set { "count": N } to create tables 1..N, or an explicit list like ["1","2","A1"]. null skips tables (add them by hand in the app).
//stewards: Waiter names for the order screen's picker, e.g. ["Kamal","Nimal"]. [] skips them (the owner adds them on site).
